trap.label: curriculum / resume
trap.wrong: I sent my curriculum to the company.
trap.right: I sent my résumé to the company.
trap.why: Curriculum em português = currículo; em inglês americano, resume ou CV.

fix.wrong: Actually I am studying English this month.
fix.right: Currently I am studying English this month.

rewrite.prompt: Passe ao passado: “She takes a course.”
Reescreva com although: “I was tired. I went to work.”
rewrite.answer: Although I was tired, I went to work.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com have/get done: “Someone checked my CV.”
